scope: Target-free three-component force sampling and convergence above the disk for the common-basis source fields. No observed motion or inferred vertical gravity is opened.
sampling: Centered finite-difference gradients at grid nodes, followed by trilinear interpolation. Only strictly interior stencils are permitted.
vertical_component_diagnostic: Report vertical-force differences separately with their own denominator; no standalone vertical-component acceptance threshold is asserted by a full-vector pass.
limitations: These checks extend numerical coverage to the explicitly sampled heights. They do not validate every location or the continuum limit.
One-at-a-time vertical, lateral and box perturbations do not bound joint-refinement cross terms.
Conditional force differences are not measurements of gas thickness or stellar vertical motions.
The same source, geometry, environment and likelihood admission gaps remain.
